Collector Stone:
When the Heavenly Rift closed, the abode of gods was created hidden from view in the clouds. Have you ever been there?
Everything changes in the Tower of Insolence, and now you can transmute scrolls into Stones of Memory vith the help of special craft.
As I`m sure you know, the Stone of Memory does not disappear when used, so you can use it again and again.
If you already have a Stone of Memory, I can exchange it for a Stone of Memory for a lower floor
By the way, don't you forget that Scroll of Escape and Stone of Memory can be of use for you only in the Tower of Insolence,
